scope: Whole active PRD plus owner requirements; earlier local milestone acceptance is supporting evidence, not completion of an entire requirement. Inherited requirements remain applicable.
completionRule: Never complete the whole product while a required requirement, selected profile, provider/operations acceptance, or real-user pilot remains open. Historical proof is immutable.

releaseProfile.engineeringRecommendation: Native accounting first, with optional bound external accounting per company; one official source per company book. Owner asked for a recommendation; actual company setup remains explicit.
releaseProfile.businessModelTarget: Owner clarified 2026-11-08: ready across business models, catalogued families and validated hybrid compositions. Continue local implementation and acceptance matrices without requiring a first customer/model choice. Per-model profiles define explicit configuration, mandatory workflows and evidence; no universal readiness is inferred.
releaseProfile.ownerDecision: Owner decided 2026-11-14: Archava targets Indonesia and a global market. Business-model coverage stays as clarified on 2026-11-08; no single industry is selected.

profiles.fits: Sales, purchasing, billing, payments, accommodation and the accounting source bridges already record whole-IDR amounts.
openBeforeAcceptance: Accounting source is still undecided (native GL is the engineering recommendation).
No transaction carries Indonesian tax: the PPN/PPh formulas in crates/domain/src/erp/tax_indonesia.rs are used by no module, and no tax rule has been reviewed by a tax professional.
No production host, pilot user or priority integration is chosen.

profiles.fits: The general ledger accepts any ISO 4217 book currency from config/accounting-currencies.v1.json.
openBeforeAcceptance: Commerce, purchasing, supplier documents and accommodation constrain currency to IDR in their schemas, and the invoice, purchase and stock source bridges require an IDR book; a non-IDR company cannot sell, buy or post sources.
Money entry, import and several screens assume whole IDR amounts.
No country, tax regime or first currency outside Indonesia is named; none is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Customer, supplier, item, entity, dokumen dan external reference memiliki identitas stabil serta hubungan yang tervalidasi. Dari order dapat ditelusuri fulfillment, invoice, payment dan accounting; nama bebas tidak menjadi satu-satunya penghubung
remaining: Authoritative accounting/book/source links and selected-profile lifecycle evidence.

requirements.requirement: Uang, quantity, currency, rounding, waktu dan revisi memakai aturan eksplisit. Transisi menjaga audit, idempotency dan concurrency; koreksi tidak menghapus histori atau mengubah original cost secara diam-diam
remaining: Financial currency/rounding/period/opening and full correction/reconciliation oracles.

requirements.requirement: Ledger resmi persisten menerima posting seimbang, source document, periode, pembalikan dan referensi. Jika eksternal, mapping dan status sinkronisasinya dapat direkonsiliasi; library GL saja tidak lulus
remaining: Complete AP/AR payments/aging, bank, opening/import, counted stock adjustments, full subledger close and profile-specific financial lifecycle. Future whole-IDR purchase/stock/invoice source cooperation and native review have bounded local acceptance. External declaration is not a tested connector.

requirements.requirement: Requisition/PO sesuai scope, partial/rejected receipt, vendor bill, toleransi three-way match, AP dan supplier payment terhubung; mismatch ditahan untuk review sesuai policy
remaining: Supplier payment, terms/aging, supported matching tolerances and complete bank/subledger close remain. Future whole-IDR receipt, matched goods claim and void source posting have scoped native/browser evidence; no complete supplier-payment lifecycle is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Order, fulfillment, invoice/credit note, AR, terms/aging, payment/refund dan inventory cost terhubung. Retry atau webhook berulang tidak menggandakan revenue, stok atau pembayaran
remaining: AR terms/aging, formal credit-document/allocation controls, complete bank/collection lifecycle and full subledger close remain. One-company IDR fulfillment/restock, actual invoice, verified gateway collection/refund and reviewed invoice correction cooperate with exact source posting in a bounded local scenario.

requirements.requirement: Bank/cash records, statement import, fee, settlement, matching dan exception dapat direkonsiliasi terhadap saldo serta ledger resmi. Provider payment status saja tidak memenuhi requirement
remaining: The dated manual-bank, supplier-payment, gateway-clearing and due-term/as-of profiles have source-bound local acceptance, including original B01 and explicit collection/refund fees. Real bank formats, statement corrections, grouped/FX payouts, complete selected-profile financial cooperation and real-user acceptance remain.

requirements.requirement: Trial balance, laba rugi, neraca, arus kas, ledger detail, subledger dan period close cocok ke sumber; closed period menolak perubahan tidak sah dan membuka kembali melalui policy berizin
remaining: Native GL/source reports, reviewed manual-bank controls and whole-book dated AR/AP source-to-GL comparisons have source-bound local native/browser/restart/upgrade/recovery acceptance. Complete stock subledger reconciliation, opening/import controls and complete selected-profile period close remain.

requirements.requirement: Tax, localization, opening balances dan effective dating mengikuti aturan scope yang ditelaah pihak kompeten. Export/filing serta integrasi resmi diuji bila dijanjikan; komentar PSAK/IFRS tidak menjadi sertifikasi

remaining: Requirement-specific mapped execution and selected-profile acceptance remain; a passing milestone or source file alone is insufficient.

requirements.requirement: Model/profile, budget, quota, timeout dan retry eksplisit. Provider down, output rusak atau referensi salah menghasilkan recovery/klarifikasi yang aman dan manual fallback. A subsequent diagnostic receives HTTP429; no model/key substitution or further inference retry is used. New staged reads preserve the original three-total-call limit and pass local authority/budget tests; actual CRM reasoning and six-turn acceptance remain unverified pending provider availability. Held-out trials, aggregate cost/availability reporting and evaluated model variation remain.

requirements.requirement: Sizing, workload, concurrency, data volume dan konfigurasi dikunci. Laporkan p50/p95, errors, saturation, recovery dan biaya; pertahankan target Commerce 50 ms yang masih terbuka sampai ada perubahan requirement beralasan dan tercatat
remaining: The bounded fcd94e local Commerce workload meets the unchanged 50ms target in repeated actual API/browser observations. New code still needs its own current-source proof; selected hardware/profile mixed workloads, saturation/recovery/cost, production capacity and real-user acceptance remain.

Current f6b74cf full browser correctness passed, but Commerce p95 55.98 ms exceeds its unchanged 50 ms local target. Five subsequent registered repetitions met the same target (Commerce p95 14.32–15.23 ms); retain the first miss and investigate variation before claiming production tail reliability. Neither run accepts production capacity or the complete performance budget.
